verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS document-processing platform with jobs and workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only pull-style job APIs for triggering runs and monitoring status, plus REST, SDK and MCP access. Nothing in the pack shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions, and status polling is an adjacent capability that does not count as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
